svg.title: Flipbook — music video style reference (b1-flipbook)
svg.desc: Somebody drawing the song. Lyric flat and still along the top, a stick-figure stage underneath where everything that moves lives. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.
svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
Hand-lettered title, one figure, nothing else
One scene per line. The figure crosses the
frame as the verse goes on.
The band inverts to pencil, the stage fills —
everyone in the song at once.
